verdict.rationale: The API guide explicitly supports scoping an API key to a group so it lacks admin access, and gives the example of an AI tool using a key scoped to a group with the Workspace viewer role. Keys are passed as bearer tokens, and the docs describe role-based permissions and ownership boundaries. Missing for 10: detail on how fine-grained scopes can be (per-resource or per-action), key expiry/rotation/revocation documentation, how scoping applies to MCP server authentication, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
